name: Algebraic Identity Obfuscation
description: Replaces the simple inequality constraint with an algebraically equivalent polynomial inequality, further masked by a modulo operation. The condition `(x^3 + y^3) % 97 > (x^2 y + x y^2) % 97` evaluates to exactly `x != y` for the domain {1, 2, 3}. This prevents the model from immediately recognizing the 3-coloring reduction, reducing the likelihood it triggers specialized graph coloring algorithms like degree-ordered MRV backtracking, and forcing it into naive backtracking which will TLE.
